---
title: "Citation BibTeX block without code-copy"
author: "Author name"
date: "2025-01-01"
format: html
citation: true
code-copy: false
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        -
          - '#quarto-citation pre.quarto-appendix-bibtex'
        -
          - '#quarto-citation button.code-copy-button'
          - '#quarto-citation div.code-copy-outer-scaffold'
---

With `code-copy: false`, clipboard.js is not loaded, so a copy button on the BibTeX block in the citation appendix would do nothing. The BibTeX block is still rendered, but without the copy button or its scaffold, the same as other code blocks in the document (#15207).
